name: Maui Waui | Melted Diamond Live Resin Vaporizer | 1g (Reload)
description: Welcome to the next generation of vaping. Clocking in at up to 95% potency, our live resin melted diamonds pair perfectly with our new hardware, designed to create ultra big clouds and super smooth hits. Maui Waui Take a trip to a tropical paradise with this vibey strain. Originally bred in Hawaii, Maui Waui is a quiet island of bliss. Notes of pineapple and banana add some fruity lightness to this profile.
